module counter_05 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input kick,
  output fault
);

  // Define the time window duration
  localparam int TIME_WINDOW = 10; // Example time window in clock cycles

  // Register to store the current count
  reg [3:0] count;

  // Register to indicate if a kick pulse was received within the time window
  reg kick_received;

  // Combinational block to update the fault signal
  always @(*) begin
    fault = 0;
    if (rst_n == 0) begin
      fault = 1;
    end else if (kick_received) begin
      kick_received = 0;
    end else if (count == TIME_WINDOW) begin
      fault = 1;
    end
  end

  // Sequential block to update the count
  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      count <= 0;
      kick_received <= 0;
    end else begin
      if (kick) begin
        if (count < TIME_WINDOW) begin
          count <= count + 1;
        end else begin
          kick_received <= 1;
        end
      end else begin
        count <= 0;
        kick_received <= 0;
      end
    end
  end

endmodule
